name: LeaseSurance
positioning: Deposit-free lease insurance that replaces the cash security deposit for institutional residential and commercial landlords.
description: LeaseSurance provides insurance-backed cover that substitutes for a cash security deposit. Its Zero Deposit product covers residential portfolios and Zero Capital covers commercial ones, both underwritten by a licensed insurer; tenants pay a small monthly fee instead of a lump sum, and landlords hold cover set at a multiple of monthly rent instead of a single month's deposit. LeaseHub is the digital platform that gives landlords portfolio-level visibility and claim administration, and ZD Rewards is a residential program that reduces cover cost for tenants with a good payment record.
real_estate_use: An institutional landlord or portfolio manager wants to remove the cash deposit as a barrier to move-in without giving up loss protection. Instead of holding a locked trust-account deposit and administering set-offs and disputes at move-out, the landlord holds an insurance policy sized at several months' rent, and a licensed claims administrator settles losses in days rather than negotiating a refund with the outgoing tenant.
features: Zero Capital commercial deposit and guarantee replacement
Claims administration by a licensed insurer

use_cases.job: Replace the cash security deposit with insurance-backed cover across a residential portfolio
Standardise deposit-free leasing terms across an institutional multifamily or commercial portfolio
